terminal_margin.limitation: Reference weights only; finite M does not guarantee completion.

resume_policy: Matching configuration, model sources, versions, and prefix hashes only.

summary.error_reduction: Across-seed means and sample std conditional on successful point fits.
summary.slope_caveat: Only 5 independent seeds; noisy descriptive scaling evidence. Slopes are undefined if any mean error is zero or missing.
summary.uncertainty_note: Bootstrap intervals describe each dataset; across-seed sample std describes independent datasets. Coverage and asymptotic comparisons are descriptive, not pass/fail.
